title: MZ Plugin Request – Using Map Screenshot as Battle Background (No Fade Transition)

posts.author: vandrac123
posts.body:
Hello,
I would like to inquire about the availability of a programmer to create a custom plugin.
The system I am developing involves a battle system that takes place directly on the map, in a style similar to Chrono Trigger. However, the currently available solutions for this approach have proven to be unstable. Creating a plugin that fully rewrites RPG Maker’s default battle system would not be financially viable for my budget and is beyond my technical skill set, so I began considering a safer alternative: simulating this style of battle using existing RPG Maker features.
At the moment, I use camera control plugins and party follower movement control plugins. The flow I have in mind is the following: when the player character comes into contact with an enemy event on the map, I would position, via event commands, both the party members and the enemies exactly where they would stand at the start of battle.
This is where the plugin would come in.
I would like the plugin to transition into battle without any fade in or fade out. Since RPG Maker already has a screenshot function, the idea would be to use the current map framing as the battle background. This would create the feeling that the battle is happening directly on the map, even though the battle system itself would remain the default side-view system.
Do you think this approach is technically feasible?
PS. I would be open to discussing a price for the creation of the plugin.
